In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], parts of [[Wraith Squadron]] and [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] attempted a '''raid''' on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Lavisar/Legends|Lavisar]]. During the battle, a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] intelligence team detonated a fake bomb when Wraith Squadron approached the world. The Wraiths then purposefully fled from the battle, pursued by planetary defenders. During their escape they were able to wipe out a small [[Moon/Legends|lunar]] garrison launched to intercept them. The Wraiths suffered no casualties, though the defenders lost numerous [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].
